The Best Movies Set In The Ocean

Originally published 3 July 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Lists & Recommendations

When it comes to movies set in the ocean, there's something universally captivating about the blend of adventure, danger, and mystery the open sea provides. From thrilling rescues to legendary voyages, ocean-based films have a special place in the hearts of moviegoers. We recently added this list to our partners over at Revu-It, and here are our picks for some of the best ocean movies that have made waves on the big screen.

Vote and add your favourite to the list:

Waterworld (1995)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Kevin ReynoldsCast: Kevin Costner, Dennis Hopper, Jeanne Tripplehorn

In a dystopian future where the polar ice caps have melted, turning Earth into a vast ocean, a mutant seafarer (Kevin Costner) becomes embroiled in a quest to find 'Dryland'—the last remaining piece of terra firma. Despite initial criticism, Waterworld has gained a cult following for its ambitious scope and imaginative setting.

Flipper (1963)

Advertisement

Genre: AdventureDirector: James B. ClarkCast: Chuck Connors, Luke Halpin, Connie Scott

A heartwarming tale about a young boy, Sandy, who rescues a dolphin named Flipper. When his father insists Flipper be released, the grateful dolphin returns to save Sandy from sharks. Flipper is a classic family film that sparked an enduring love for dolphins in popular culture.

In the Heart of the Sea (2015)

Genre: ThrillerDirector: Ron HowardCast: Chris Hemsworth, Benjamin Walker, Cillian Murphy

Based on the true story that inspired Herman Melville's Moby-Dick, this film chronicles the harrowing journey of the whaling ship Essex after it is attacked by a giant whale. The crew's survival against the odds is both a thrilling and poignant tale.

Kon-Tiki (2012)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Joachim Rønning, Espen SandbergCast: Pål Sverre Hagen, Anders Baasmo Christiansen

This film depicts the true story of Thor Heyerdahl's daring 1947 expedition across the Pacific on a balsa wood raft to prove that South Americans could have settled in Polynesia. Kon-Tiki is an inspiring and visually stunning adventure.

The Perfect Storm (2000)

Genre: ActionDirector: Wolfgang PetersenCast: George Clooney, Mark Wahlberg, Diane Lane

Based on a true story, this film follows the crew of the Andrea Gail, a commercial fishing vessel caught in a massive storm in the North Atlantic. The Perfect Storm combines incredible special effects with gripping human drama.

White Squall (1996)

Advertisement

Genre: DramaDirector: Ridley ScottCast: Jeff Bridges, Caroline Goodall, John Savage

In 1960, a group of prep school students embarks on a sailing voyage to learn discipline and fortitude under the stern Captain Sheldon. When they encounter a deadly white squall, their survival is put to the ultimate test.

Wind (1992)

Genre: ActionDirector: Carroll BallardCast: Matthew Modine, Jennifer Grey, Cliff Robertson

Wind tells the story of a determined yachtsman who leads his crew in the America's Cup race. The film captures the spirit of competitive sailing and the personal stakes involved in pursuing victory.

The Finest Hours (2016)

Genre: ActionDirector: Craig GillespieCast: Chris Pine, Casey Affleck, Ben Foster

Set in 1952, this true story follows the daring rescue attempt by the Coast Guard off the coast of Cape Cod after two oil tankers are destroyed in a blizzard. The Finest Hours showcases heroic bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.

Dead Calm (1989)

Genre: ThrillerDirector: Phillip NoyceCast: Nicole Kidman, Sam Neill, Billy Zane

An Australian couple's peaceful sailing trip turns into a nightmare when they rescue a man from a sinking ship, only to discover he's a psychotic murderer. Dead Calm is a tense, suspenseful thriller set on the high seas.

Mutiny on the Bounty (1962)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Lewis MilestoneCast: Marlon Brando, Trevor Howard, Richard Harris

This classic recounts the infamous mutiny aboard the HMS Bounty, led by Fletcher Christian against the tyrannical Captain Bligh. The film is a gripping tale of rebellion and survival.

The Bounty (1984)

Genre: ActionDirector: Roger DonaldsonCast: Mel Gibson, Anthony Hopkins, Daniel Day-Lewis

Another take on the story of the HMS Bounty, this version delves deeper into the motivations of the mutineers and the subsequent journey of Captain Bligh to safety. The performances by Gibson and Hopkins are particularly notable.

All Is Lost (2013)

Genre: ActionDirector: J.C. ChandorCast: Robert Redford

A solo sailor faces his mortality after his boat is damaged in a collision with a shipping container, leaving him adrift in the Indian Ocean. All Is Lost is a minimalist, yet powerful, survival story featuring a remarkable performance by Robert Redford.

The Poseidon Adventure (1972)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Ronald NeameCast: Gene Hackman, Ernest Borgnine, Red Buttons

When an ocean liner capsizes, a group of passengers must navigate their way to safety through the upside-down ship. The Poseidon Adventure is a classic disaster film that combines thrilling action with human drama.

Swiss Family Robinson (1960)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Ken AnnakinCast: John Mills, Dorothy McGuire, James MacArthur

After being shipwrecked, the Robinson family adapts to life on a deserted island, creating an idyllic new home while facing threats from nature and pirates. Swiss Family Robinson is a beloved family adventure.

Titanic (1997)

Genre: DramaDirector: James CameronCast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Kate Winslet

James Cameron's epic romance and disaster film follows the ill-fated voyage of the RMS Titanic. The love story between Jack and Rose, set against the backdrop of one of the most infamous maritime disasters, captivated audiences worldwide.

Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World (2003)

Genre: AdventureDirector: Peter WeirCast: Russell Crowe, Paul Bettany

Set during the Napoleonic Wars, this film follows Captain Jack Aubrey and his crew as they pursue a formidable French warship. Master and Commander is lauded for its historical accuracy and thrilling naval battles.

Whale Rider (2003)

Genre: DramaDirector: Niki CaroCast: Keisha Castle-Hughes, Rawiri Paratene

In this heartwarming story, a young Maori girl fights to fulfil her destiny as the leader of her tribe, challenging the longstanding traditions of her community. Whale Rider is a moving tale of determination and cultural heritage.

Captain Phillips (2013)

Genre: ThrillerDirector: Paul GreengrassCast: Tom Hanks, Barkhad Abdi

Based on the true story of the 2009 hijacking of the MV Maersk Alabama, this gripping film follows Captain Richard Phillips as he faces Somali pirates. Tom Hanks delivers a powerful performance in this intense, real-life drama.

Cast Away (2000)

Genre: DramaDirector: Robert ZemeckisCast: Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt

After a plane crash, a FedEx employee is stranded on a deserted island, where he must survive physically and emotionally. Cast Away is a profound exploration of isolation and resilience, with a memorable performance by Tom Hanks.

Adrift (2018)

Genre: Adventure ThrillerDirector: Baltasar KormákurCast: Shailene Woodley , Sam Claflin

Tami Oldham and Richard Sharp couldn't anticipate that they would be sailing directly into one of the most catastrophic hurricanes in recorded history. In the aftermath of the storm, Tami awakens to find Richard badly injured and their boat in ruins. With no hope of rescue, Tami must now find the strength and determination to save herself and the only man she has ever loved.

These ocean-set movies take audiences on thrilling adventures and emotional journeys, showcasing the beauty, danger, and mystery of life at sea. Whether through harrowing true stories or imaginative tales, they offer a glimpse into the vast and unpredictable world of the ocean.

Yes, I did not forget about Jaws or The Abyss... and if you think Aquaman should be on this list then you on the wrong site!
